description: A server can have up to `100` FAQs, organised into up to `25` categories.

Every FAQ belongs to a category, and has an ID within that category. Categories and IDs can each be up to `32` characters long, and are converted to lowercase, with spaces and underscores replaced by hyphens. When an FAQ is displayed, its category and ID are shown title-cased, so `getting-started` and `download` become `Getting Started: Download`.
FAQs can also have up to `10` ID aliases: alternative IDs that the FAQ can be looked up by.

The <command:faq [id]|faq category:[category] id:[id]> command supports fuzzy matching, making it easy to look up your FAQs. The FAQ management commands require exact categories and IDs to ensure you select the right one.

tabs.name: Adding FAQs
content: To add or update an FAQ, use the <command:addfaq|serverconfig faq add> command. This command requires the `Manage Server` permission.
Press the button to open the FAQ builder. The slash command skips this step and opens the form directly.

components: Press the button to start creating an FAQ

content: A modal will appear where you can enter the FAQ's category, ID, and text.
Any `@user`, `@role`, `#channel`, and `:emoji:` names typed into the FAQ text are automatically converted into real mentions and emojis.
Next, you can optionally set up some extra FAQ options, or press skip to finish.

content: The lookup is fuzzy matched against each FAQ's `category-id` combination, its ID, and its aliases, so a close enough spelling will still find the right FAQ.

tabs.name: Getting the raw text
content: To get the raw text of an FAQ, use the <command:rawfaq [category] [id]|serverconfig faq raw category:[category] id:[id]> command. This command requires the `Manage Server` permission.
For example: <command:rawfaq getting-started download|serverconfig faq raw category:getting-started id:download>

Wynem will send a `getting-started-download.txt` file containing the FAQ's raw text. If the FAQ has any extra data, like an image or aliases, a `getting-started-download-data.json` file is also sent containing it.
This is useful when updating an FAQ, as you can copy the raw text back into the FAQ builder without losing any formatting.

tabs.name: Renaming FAQs
content: To rename an FAQ, or move it to a different category, use the <command:renamefaq [oldCategory] [oldId] [newCategory] [newId]|serverconfig faq rename old-category:[oldCategory] old-id:[oldId] new-category:[newCategory] new-id:[newId]> command. This command requires the `Manage Messages` permission.
For example: <command:renamefaq getting-started download getting-started downloads|serverconfig faq rename old-category:getting-started old-id:download new-category:getting-started new-id:downloads>

content: The old and new names must be different, and the new name must not already be in use by another FAQ.

tabs.name: Removing FAQs
content: To remove an FAQ, use the <command:removefaq [category] [id]|serverconfig faq remove category:[category] id:[id]> command. This command requires the `Manage Messages` permission.
For example: <command:removefaq getting-started download|serverconfig faq remove category:getting-started id:download>
You will be prompted to confirm you want to remove the FAQ.
